info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

This is a 15-20 year old (guesstimate) single wide mobile home. The yard is cluttered with debris including several sheds and an inoperable vehicle that appears to be used as additional storage.. 70's era roofover mobile home in the Meadow Woods subdivision near Chums Corners and Grawn. Mobile is fairly solid, and appears to have been occupied through summer 2025 based on dated things found inside. Vacant parcel in a clean, nice, newer SITE CONDO near Traverse City. If you're not familiar with site condominiums, you may wish to review the ownership type before bidding. Parcels here are liable for COA fees of about $1200 a year which cover private roads and other community assets. The unit is in an area  of well kept newer single family homes. Vacant Lot on West Ave which is a dead end, rutted street that may not be County maintained. It seems that the adjacent property owners are using some or all of this parcel for storage of personal property/debris and an extension of their driveway/parking. Located in a quiet subdivision just off US 31 between Interlochen and Grawn. Home has been vandalized with spray paint and interiod abuse. Living room ceiling is down, but not from roof leaks or plumbing issues ... either critters or intentional abuse/vandalism. The bones here are solid. Likely freeze damage to plumbing. Small, wood frame home 3 or 4 miles SW of Traverse City off Silver Lake Road north of Grawn. We would guess this as a 70's or 80's home, but it has a 150A electric service panel with a 2021 inspection sticker, so there have been upgrades. Central air HVAC. Modern (possibly modular) construction home in the Fife Lake area, just NW of US 131. OCCUPIED. When we visited in mid June, there were still visible indications of occupancy including power and lights on, and a garage wide open. The property is still furnished. Of Traverse Citys two bays, East Bay is the shallower, sandier and warmer option. This is a two bedroom, second floor unit with a deck overlooking the association beach. Very nice open, level, well drained lot on Cedar Run Road NW of Long Lake. 100 feet along the north side of the road, and about 500' deep to the north.

At the SW corner of Pierce and 2nd in Fife Lake. Level, dry, wooded parcel that is probably too small to build on under zoning. We would check that if we were interested in it for that purpose. Well and septic are the rule here. No municipal utilities noted, tho we do see natural gas at adjoining parcels.
